systems.country_label: EMIS; national data warehouse integrating multiple data systems

note: GPE KIX blog on a February 2025 exchange hosted by Eswatini. For Sierra Leone it names a newly drafted (elsewhere 'completed') EMIS policy, a national data warehouse, a digital Master Schools List and a call centre, and says the SEMIS pilots of Eswatini and The Gambia can guide adoption in Sierra Leone; it does not say what any Sierra Leonean system records or who enters it, so no class and no fact.
